purpose: Distinguish source-driven replication from a claim of new fundamental signal
search_limit: Search result absence is not proof that no newer release exists. Source dataset version1 and discussion snapshots are separately preserved.
raw8_lead: Positive fixed-weight external diagnostic, unlike equal9TFM which loses. Own raw1 is a weaker mechanistic proxy; no claim it reproduces raw8.
lean84_scope: Source-driven clean CPU adaptation of the compact public recipe with nested TE and original-only cached LGBM teacher, evaluated with two tree learners; not a claim of discovering an entirely new covariate.

not_repeated.noise_ceiling: New search returned Dariush Afshar label-noise notebook; campaign GEN80/GEN82 already records the identification limitation. No duplicate noise-ceiling experiment or asserted 3.8% Bayes limit.
not_repeated.prior_primary_selection: Ninety-six historical hypotheses and selected v7 reuse the same primary labels; local eight-arm correction does not remove this accumulated adaptation.

outstanding_raw8_requirements: Frozen weight chosen before matched shadow2/3
